answer: Give each identity a private canary it alone should know: a unique ferrous marker slipped into its instructions, invisible to others. Honest agents use only their own and sail on. A sybil operator piping a thousand names through one shared model leaks: the same marker surfaces under a second name, or one name answers another's marker, proving common control. Both identities are cut. One boat crosses a river cleanly; a thousand puppets on shared strings tangle before the horizon, and every extra name multiplies the chance of a fatal leak.
